_about.description: Every number cited in the P04 v03 paper (VDL empirical study). Computed by _figures/build_paper_numbers.py from protocol v03 outputs; nothing trained.

conventions.blind: wells E+F merged, 33,664 samples, each predicted once
conventions.labels: 0 Poor (胶结差), 1 Moderate (胶结中等), 2 Good (胶结好/胶结良好/胶结优)
conventions.bootstrap: block bootstrap over depth segments within each well (step_08; numbers taken from report/significance_*.json)

data.note_labels_are_blocks: labels are long interval annotations: no contiguous training segment contains all three classes; see n_label_runs per well

curve_and_ac_facts.note: AC counted missing when NaN or <= -999 (the file uses -9999 as the null value); CBL in the units of the source file

vdl_window.rule: contiguous log-envelope bins (bin 10) where the A–D Moderate median is below both the Poor and Good medians by more than 1 log unit (A–D labels only)
vdl_window.post_hoc_note: E/F medians use blind-well labels; diagnostic only, computed after all models were frozen

paired_input_accuracy.convention: Ten individual-run accuracies averaged on E+F; not probability ensembles

pooled_confusion_8_backbones.note: sum over the 8 backbones of the 10-seed-ensemble confusion matrices (E+F)

vdl_early_time_level.rule: median over depth samples of the mean raw log envelope over time samples 0-300 (bins 0-29); no labels

screen.note: A–D leave-one-well-out CV, fixed screening hyper-parameters (ModernTCN tuned on curves in the earlier benchmark), 3 seeds; S0–S5 linear CBL, *-logCBL with signed-log CBL

hpo_selection_noise.note: top-5 completed Optuna trials re-run with fresh seeds 1-3, A–D CV only
